description: Three sample and hold channels, each with a second output that quantises the held value to a step in semitones

params.text: Sets the quantiser step in semitones, a whole number from 1 to 12
Nothing that can run reads this knob: it filters an internal noise source that the module's channel loop can never reach

inputs.text: Samples that channel's input on each rising edge above 2V, reading low again below 0.1V
The signal that channel samples, and the jack that sets how many polyphonic channels that section carries

outputs.text: The last value sampled on that channel
The last value sampled on that channel, cut to a whole number of quantiser steps

notes: a channel does nothing at all until a cable is patched to its IN jack: the loop that does the work is bounded by that jack's channel count, so with nothing patched the whole section is skipped
the held value and the edge detector are shared by every polyphonic channel of a section, so all the channels of an output carry the same sample
